title: Exact affine realization with original-unit normalizations
statement: For a ring A and a scheme Y with derived categories, package additivity and finite-limit/colimit preservation of a module-to-sheaf functor E as proof data and define its actual derived realization. Define affine tilde by the actual exact associated-sheaf functor [lem-sc-tilde-preserves-finite-limits] and the restriction-tilde composition by its standard exact-derived comparison. Normalize the ordinary affine pushforward comparison by the tilde/Gamma unit [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] and the identity-on-elements affine global-sections comparison [lem-weil-pbc-pushforward-spec-global-sections]. Normalize a derived image comparison on every homotopy complex by the original right-derived direct-image units [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] and the homotopy localization of the specified ordinary comparison. Use the shared restriction conventions [def-trf-polynomial-duality-restriction-atlas]. No dualizing complex or chart identification is an input.
